title: River creatures, and only river creatures, allowed to spawn on LAKE. Every non-vermin creature carrying a RIVER biome token in the vanilla raws (19 species; LAKE holds the tropical ten in its river feature entries) is opened at 50 on every tile in every layer; every other Animal entry on the site and its ring, surface, cavern and feature alike, is closed; every hold in every layer released, and released again every 1500 ticks. Edge water at every z, the map's feature list and map_edge's fields are logged first. Any arrival at all is a river creature. Runs to 100,800 ticks or six arrivals.
fork: F5 retested the way the user asked (17 Sep): E5 held the door open 20,000 ticks with caverns still drawing; E26 only watched natural play. If river life still does not come, the arrival code has no river path on 53.16 and seasonal-wildlife supplies it (E30 placement).

predictions.model: DF has a river arrival path with its own gate or timer
predictions.expects: river-species arrivals with layer=feature within the run; timing tells the gate

predictions.model: river feature entries are never drawn on 53.16
predictions.expects: zero arrivals of any kind for the whole run while edge water is present
edge water absent or only at a z the entry code ignores; nothing arrives

kill_criterion: one river-species arrival settles existence; a full run with none and edge water present closes the path
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: river_only
pre: local n,zs,minz,maxz=0,{},999,-1; local d=df.global.world.map; local W,H=d.x_count,d.y_count; for z=0,d.z_count-1 do local cnt=0; for x=0,W-1 do for _,y in ipairs({0,H-1}) do local b=dfhack.maps.getTileBlock(x,y,z); if b then local des=b.designation[x%16][y%16]; if des.flow_size>=4 and not des.liquid_type then cnt=cnt+1 end end end end; for y=0,H-1 do for _,x in ipairs({0,W-1}) do local b=dfhack.maps.getTileBlock(x,y,z); if b then local des=b.designation[x%16][y%16]; if des.flow_size>=4 and not des.liquid_type then cnt=cnt+1 end end end end; if cnt>0 then n=n+cnt; zs[#zs+1]=z..':'..cnt; if z<minz then minz=z end; if z>maxz then maxz=z end end end; print(('edge water: %d edge tiles with water>=4 across z %d..%d [%s]'):format(n, minz, maxz, table.concat(zs,' ')))

local out={}; local ok,err=pcall(function() for i,f in ipairs(df.global.world.features.map_features) do out[#out+1]=i..':'..tostring(f._type) end end); print('map_features:', ok and table.concat(out,' ') or ('err '..tostring(err))); local me={}; for k,v in pairs(df.global.plotinfo.map_edge) do local n; pcall(function() n=#v end); me[#me+1]=tostring(k)..'='..tostring(n or v) end; print('map_edge fields:', table.concat(me,' '))

local RIVER={['ALLIGATOR']=true,['ALLIGATOR SNAPPING TURTLE']=true,['BEAVER']=true,['BIRD_OSPREY']=true,['CROCODILE_SALTWATER']=true,['FISH_CARP']=true,['FISH_GAR_LONGNOSE']=true,['FISH_LAMPREY_SEA']=true,['FISH_MILKFISH']=true,['FISH_PIKE']=true,['FISH_STINGRAY']=true,['FISH_STURGEON']=true,['FISH_TIGERFISH']=true,['HIPPO']=true,['MINK']=true,['PLATYPUS']=true,['RIVER OTTER']=true,['SNAPPING TURTLE']=true,['SPONGE']=true}; local site=df.world_site.find(df.global.plotinfo.site_id); local x0,x1=math.floor(site.global_min_x/16),math.floor(site.global_max_x/16); local y0,y1=math.floor(site.global_min_y/16),math.floor(site.global_max_y/16); local o,c,k=0,0,0; for _,p in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local r=p.population; if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal and p.quantity_max<10000000 then local cr=df.creature_raw.find(p.race); local id=cr and cr.creature_id or ''; local inring=(r.region_x>=x0-1 and r.region_x<=x1+1 and r.region_y>=y0-1 and r.region_y<=y1+1); if RIVER[id] then if p.quantity<50 then p.quantity=50 end; p.flags.extinct=false; o=o+1 elseif inring then p.quantity=0; p.flags.extinct=true; c=c+1 else k=k+1 end end end; print(('river whitelist: %d river-species entries open (>=50, any tile, any layer); %d non-river entries on site+ring closed (surface, cavern, feature alike); %d entries beyond the ring left alone'):format(o,c,k))
